infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: VaultChat needs camera for video calls and face scan
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: VaultChat needs microphone for voice and video calls
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: VaultChat uses speech recognition to transcribe your voice into text
infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: VaultChat uses Face ID to protect your messages
infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: VaultChat needs contacts to find people you know
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: VaultChat needs location to share your position with contacts
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: VaultChat needs photo access to send and save media
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: VaultChat saves photos and videos you download or create to your photo library.
infoPlist.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: VaultChat sends large files directly to a nearby device over your local network, so the transfer is fast and the file never leaves your network.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: VaultChat shares your location with your Family Space circle so they can see you are safe. This continues in the background only while location sharing is switched on.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: VaultChat shares your location with your Family Space circle while location sharing is switched on.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: VaultChat uses motion to tell whether you are moving, so Family Space can slow location updates when you are still and save battery.
